title: Pakistan's NCCIA says it caught a Karachi gang that phoned elderly people in a fraud scheme and recovered cash
date_note: Express's page is dated 25 November and does not state the day of the arrests.
geo_basis: Karachi, where the gang was reported caught; city centre coordinates
summary: Express (Urdu) and Jang report that the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) caught an alleged gang of three friends in Karachi, as announced by Additional Director Shahzad Akbar. According to the reports, they lured elderly people with health-related pretexts, and Rs 15 crore in cash was recovered.
plain: Pakistan's cybercrime agency says it caught an alleged gang of three friends in Karachi who lured elderly people with health-related pretexts, and recovered Rs 15 crore in cash, Express and Jang report.
exec: Pakistan's cybercrime agency announced a fraud-gang arrest in Karachi; Express and Jang report the gang targeted elderly people and Rs 15 crore in cash was recovered.

validation.note: Express (Urdu) and Jang, two independent publishers, each report the NCCIA announcement by Shahzad Akbar of a three-friend gang caught in Karachi with Rs 15 crore in cash recovered. No NCCIA page was read.

review.note: duplicate merged, validation: added Jang source and Rs 15 crore figure with evidence, now corroborated; removed unsupported 'data from companies' and 'phoned' wording
